name: Kimi wa Chimera
source:
Meeting you was a calculated trap.

Can I truly say, with my head held high, that I’m glad we met?

I am still searching for the answer.

Since the day we met, the gears of my life have spiraled out of control.

I don’t blame you. I know it couldn’t possibly be your fault.

If I were to let go of your hand, I could surely return to my ordinary life.

And yet, looking at you, I find I cannot let go.

Is this feeling merely pity?

Or is it————

Yoshifumi Akiyama is a part-time cram school tutor who has abandoned his dream of becoming a school teacher.

One day on his way home, he is approached by a suspicious woman who wants to "scout" him as a private tutor.

The pay is extraordinary. Struggling to repay his student loans, Yoshifumi decides to take the job.

Following the address he was given, he arrives at a mysterious facility called the "Integrated Life Sciences Research Center."

Led into a private room, Yoshifumi meets a young girl named Hamal.

Before long, he discovers a shocking truth about Hamal and is forced to make a life-altering decision.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4367580/UR_CHIMERIC_SAI/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
遇见你，是一场精心策划的陷阱。

我真的可以昂首挺胸地说，我很高兴我们相遇吗？

我仍在寻找答案。

自从我们见面的那天起，我的生活就失去了控制。

我不怪你。我知道这不可能是你的错。

如果我放开你的手，我一定能回到平凡的生活。

然而，看着你，我发现我无法放手。

这种感觉仅仅是怜悯吗？

或者说是————

秋山芳文是一名兼职补习班导师，他放弃了成为一名学校老师的梦想。

有一天，在他回家的路上，一名可疑的女人找到他，想“发掘”他作为私人家庭教师。

薪水非同寻常。由于难以偿还学生贷款，吉文决定接受这份工作。

按照给出的地址，他到达了一个名为“综合生命科学研究中心”的神秘设施。

良文被带入一间私人房间，遇到了一位名叫哈马尔的年轻女孩。

不久之后，他发现了有关哈马尔的令人震惊的真相，并被迫做出改变生活的决定。
